race.title: PricedUp Bet Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A tough call to split interesting pair BALLYDINE BOY and Northern Olympian . Olly Murphy's fairly useful bumper winner narrowly shades the vote on hurdling debut. BALLYDINE BOY (IRE) NORTHERN OLYMPIAN (GER) SHOW YOUR HAND
